title: Use expect latest version and remove deep-equal dependency
body:
Expect has released its latest version https://github.com/mjackson/expect/releases/tag/v1.13.0 .
`toInclude` now uses `deep-equal` by default so we can:
- [ ] Upgrade expect
- [ ] Remove the dependency on `deep-equal`
- [ ] Modify `lib/utils/__tests__/utils-test.js` to not use `deep-equal` anymore
